title: <script>'s language attribute is not whitespace-stripped in actual implementations
body:
A minor issue:

In the current spec, script language attributes with valid value + trailing whitespaces would be executed, e.g.

- `<script language="javascript     ">`,
- => `the script block's type string` would be `"text/javascript    "`
- with [leading and trailing ASCII whitespace stripped](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) => `"text/javascript"`
- => [JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match) => OK

but this whitespace stripping is not performed on Safari/Firefox/Chrome, according to https://wpt.fyi/results/html/semantics/scripting-1/the-script-element/script-type-and-language-js.html.

I think it's better to modify the spec to align with the implementations, like:

- Otherwise, if the [script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-script-element) element has a [type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#attr-script-type) attribute, let the script block's type string for this [script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-script-element) element be the value of that attribute **with [leading and trailing ASCII whitespace stripped](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace)**.
- Otherwise, the element has a non-empty [language](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-script-language) attribute; let the script block's type string for this [script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#the-script-element) element be the concatenation of the string "text/" followed by the value of the [language](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/obsolete.html#attr-script-language) attribute.
- If the script block's type string <s>with [leading and trailing ASCII whitespace stripped](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace)</s> is a [JavaScript MIME type essence match](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type-essence-match), [the script's type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#concept-script-type) is "classic".
